bio: Cas and Kelly Pikaar have now set up shop in Riethoven, Cas's hometown, and welcome diners to their spacious restaurant, which has an inviting, vintage feel. One look at the tempting menu makes it clear that food lovers are in for a treat. Think rich foie gras terrine, wild hare saddle with an intense jus and creamy mashed potato, and an original take on dame blanche: The chef resolutely champions classic cuisine, occasionally lifting dishes with subtle Asian notes. His keen eye for quality ingredients shines through in creations that shun excess complexity in favour of pleasing timeless depth....
